finding_c_future_timestamp_audit.c1_explanation: When history has < 50 bars, decide() returns [] solely due to len(spy) < 50 check, NOT because timestamp was audited or rejected.
finding_c_future_timestamp_audit.c2_explanation: When sufficient historical depth (>=61 bars) is present, agent.py blindly accepts future timestamps (2099-12-31) and computes indicators on them without rejection.
finding_c_future_timestamp_audit.scientific_verdict: CRITICAL CORRECTION: agent.py DOES NOT reject future timestamps. Prior report incorrectly classified safe abstention under short history as future timestamp rejection.

duplicate_timestamps.verdict: Agent does not deduplicate timestamps; processes duplicate bars sequentially in index order.

reversed_timestamps.verdict: Agent does not validate chronological monotonicity. Oldest bar at [-1] appears below SMA50 of subsequent bars, triggering defensive mode.

shuffled_timestamps.verdict: Agent computes SMA, momentum and volatility directly on scrambled array order without sorting.

finding_d_nonmonotonic_timestamps.scientific_verdict: Agent runtime contains ZERO timestamp chronology validation. Upstream data harness must guarantee monotonic, sorted, deduplicated series.

preview_runner_causal_model.slippage_model: 5 bps for equities, 10 bps for beta > 1

empirical_e2_missing_fill_bar.verdict: Order silently drops if Day T+1 open price is None; trades drop from 38 to 34 without crash.

empirical_e3_stale_prices.verdict: Stale prices suppress momentum score, shifting allocations and reducing return from 14.65% to 11.99%.

live_runner_causal_model.signal_timing: Day T Morning (market_state contains bars with ts < date)

live_runner_causal_model.mathematical_equivalence: Identical information filtration: decide() sees information strictly through Close_{T-1} and fills at Open_T.
